text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Siiiigh…

One holiday, I went out with Sakura 
Bakushin O, but she didn't seem to be in 
the mood the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth… a classmate of mine is 
leaving the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to say goodbye to her, both as 
class president and personally…

Due to the nature of the Academy, students 
often transfer out. But that doesn't mean 
it's any easier when they have to part 
ways.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oya? Could that be…

A student in a jersey was running in front 
of me. She seemed to be heading towards 
the school.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's the classmate I was telling you 
about! I can't believe she's training at 
this hour――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I cannot allow this! 
Stop right theeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's late, you should head back. I cannot 
let a curfew breaker go unnoticed!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ughh… I know I'm not supposed to be doing 
this. But I'm running out of time!!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I have to leave the Academy. Because my 
father was transferred overseas――

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to practice for my 
last race… a mock race, so I wouldn't have 
any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Last race…

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I never ended up growing, and I never had 
a trainer… But I want to finish everything 
off with contentment!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I understand your situation. And 
I've made up my mind…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From this moment on, as class president, I 
will assist you in your training!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's okay, right, Trainer!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, but you'll have to wait for 
tomorrow, it's curfew today.

Yeah, but you'll have to wait for 
tomorrow, it's curfew today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uu, that's right! Then, special training 
starts tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With my assistance and Trainer's guidance, 
you're sure to win first place!!

The next day, I decided to hang out with 
Sakura Bakushin O and help her classmate 
train.

When I asked her what kind of mock race 
she was going to run, she replied, "Long 
distance." This was a kind of race that 
Sakura Bakushin O wasn't exactly good at.
choice_data_list:
So, what kind of practice are you planning 
on doing?

So, what kind of practice are you planning 
on doing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is Bakushin! If you 
Bakushin, you'll find your way!

The response was both unsurprising and 
unfavorable. This is――
choice_data_list: Build up your stamina and let's Bakushin!
There's a certain timing to Bakushin-ing.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that endurance and stamina to 
run the course were essential to achieve 
success in long distances.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, you certainly can't Bakushin 
if you're out of energy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I shall keep this up to the 
bitter end!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha, haah… Looks like… fuuh, that's about 
it… for today!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Baku-chan! And your Trainer, too…

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I think I have a good feeling about 
today's training. I'm sure I'll get good 
results!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's… above all else――

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan!? ……Wait, are you sleeping?

Sakura Bakushin O, a sprinter, must have 
had a tough time training with a 
long-distance runner.

However, for the sake of her classmate, 
she pushed herself to her limits and went 
along with the training anyways…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mumblemumble… It's only the… natural thing 
to dooo… snoore……

Sakura Bakushin O, still asleep, smiled 
contentedly.

I explained that she could move up in the 
rankings by Bakushin-ing at just the right 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so what you're saying is, Bakushin 
is a kind of special move!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, then, let us find the impeccable 
timing for this Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Alright, got it!

Once that was decided, the first thing to 
do was to find out what Sakura Bakushin 
O's classmate was capable of and what her 
running habits were.

I put together a training regimen that 
best suited her current situation, and 
asked her to implement it into her 
routine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew, I guess that's it for today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your training has paid off, and you've got 
the timing of your Bakushin down to a tee!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've got a good feeling about this! 
I'll make sure I get a good result!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you! Bakushin is the 
solution to everything!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. You're always there for me, 
Baku-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I'm the president of your 
class, after all!

Being thanked by her classmate seems to 
have given Sakura Bakushin O more 
confidence.
